title: Implement ExportDesignModel in Go
description: Implement the ExportDesignModel function in /workspaces/semio/compose/go/compose.go that exports a design's 3D model to GLB/glTF format. Uses BFS to compute world planes, parses GLB model files, and assembles output GLB with scene graph matching connection document.
summary: Implemented ExportDesignModel function in compose.go that exports a design's 3D model to GLB/glTF format. Added ExportModelFormats map (.glb/.gltf), helper functions for plane-to-glTF matrix conversion, box placeholder mesh generation, base64 blob decoding, GLB mesh parsing with stride handling, and tag-based model selection. The main function performs BFS to compute world planes (reusing computeChildPlane/getConnector), builds scene graph matching connection document with relative transforms via matrix inversion, extracts mesh data per type (from GLB models or box fallback), and assembles the final GLB/glTF output with proper binary packing.
